items.text: Fixed: holding a note in the hold hand shrank the grid inside its frame, a step each time. The grid now keeps its size however many notes you hold.
Going between play and edit, the bottom bar and the stage no longer move at all. The colour and shape bar keeps its place and just fades in and out.

When you draw on a square that is switched off, muted or faded by the A/B slider, the mark now appears at full colour and opacity, then eases down to how that square really looks, so you can see you are drawing.
changed: in Edit with Halo on, the faded colours and marks can be tapped. A tap wakes drawing (as the Colour or Shape button does) and picks the colour or mark you tapped.

fixed: leaving Edit no longer flashes the colour and mark bar as plain unstyled squares. The ghost of the bar that slides away had lost its styling (its names were stripped); it keeps them now, and just fades. The grid is also redrawn at once when the stage changes size, so it does not blink out for a frame.
fixed: the MIDI tab in the heads-up display's footer has its icon again (it had none, because the MIDI button it was copied from is built later than the tabs).

changed: the Statistics pane is two columns on a wide screen: the reading, the sounding/muted/empty bar and the column and row bars on the left, the colour-by-shape circles filling the right, so it fits on one page on an iPad in landscape. On a narrow screen it stacks.

changed: Halo and drawing no longer jump between each other. In Edit the colour and mark bar stays in place, dimmed and still while Halo is on, and lights up when you draw, so nothing slides, overlaps or resizes the stage.

fixed: while drawing, tapping Colour or Shape no longer switches itself on and off with nothing happening; any of them (or Halo) takes you back to Halo. Colour and Shape still start drawing from Halo.
Settings has a Size row (Small, Medium, Large). It scales the buttons of the bar and the rails (Medium is the size they have always been), and is kept on this device.
